notes.title: Drag Racing DLC released
notes.content:
[b]Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 - Drag Racing DLC[/b] is the BIG content you were waiting for!
This DLC is introducing something completely new to the world of Car Mechanic.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2112231/ss_f6e11717b7c14005d6ab63b9ea3789ecbafb5dae.1920x1080.jpg?t=1666698286[/img]

[h2][b]Game Modes[/b][/h2]
Challenge yourself at parallel races [b]with AI[/b] in several game modes:
-[b]Practice[/b] - Exam your car and configure your opponent - change his engine, tires and tuning values.
-[b]Quick Race[/b] - Pick a class and race with randomized car setups.
-[b]Single Race[/b] - Check your build and reaction time with opponent matched to your rating.
-[b]Championships[/b] - Challenge your vehicle in a series of races. Bet who will win, and grab a big prize at the end.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2112231/ss_2ddf95743a5b5f787b6810e687420bf02d7cb1ca.1920x1080.jpg?t=1666698286[/img]

All this on four distances: [b]1/8[/b], [b]1/4[/b], [b]1/2[/b] and [b]1 mile[/b].
[h2][b]Drag Rating[/b][/h2]
Each car now has a "[b]Drag Rating[/b]" index that assigns it to a particular racing category. Remember that any change in the tuning of a car, later requires checking it on the Dyno to calculate the new index.

[h2][b]Manual transmission / ECS / TCS[/b][/h2]
With this DLC we are introducing Manual Transmission. In Drag Racing it is mandatory to use manual transmission. In the rest of the tracks you can choose between automatic and manual. You can also disable ECS and TCS if you wish. (AT/MT in game options, ECS/TCS in rebind)

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2112231/ss_ef206e8f30f99e5e88669f64b958c8a3e40533eb.1920x1080.jpg?t=1666698286[/img]

[h2][b]Additional tuning[/b][/h2]
To make your car even more capable of going fast, we expand the capability to [b]tune engines[/b].

-[b]ECU Tuning[/b] - We give you three Stages of ECU. They may be not the cheapest way to tune your car, but you can push your build to the limits.
-[b]Carburetor Tuning[/b] - For classic engines, we introduce carburetor tuning. Crank the power of every carburetor.
[h2][b]Stats[/b][/h2]
After each run, detailed statistics of [b]drag times[/b] are presented, as well as general data like 0-60 times, 0-100 times, etc.
[h2][b]Bets[/b][/h2]
Are you good at [b]betting[/b]? You can bet on the results of the championship races. Another way to make some cash.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2112231/ss_9a6bd2db49c0704909ca7d3934534cac511bda62.1920x1080.jpg?t=1666698286[/img]

[h2][b]Cars[/b][/h2]
We also add 4 more fast vehicles you might like to try:

[b]Arezzo Cortona - Italian Classic[/b]
Engine: V12 DOHC ARZ
Power: 520HP
Torque: 489Nm

[b]Bolt Reptilia R6 - American Powerhouse[/b]
Engine: V8 OHV CGM M1D / V8 OHV CGM-SC M1D
Power: 490HP / 680 HP 
Torque: 627Nm / 840Nm

[b]Hammerdal Strale S - Nordic Hypercar[/b]
Engine: V8 DOHC AXK-TRS M / V8 DOHC AXK-SCRS M
Power: 910HP / 1014HP
Torque: 1065Nm / 1010Nm

[b]Mayen T8 - German Sports Car[/b]
Engine: V10 OHV MT8
Power: 525HP
Torque: 542Nm
